status: development — 28 of 100 FRQ items have deterministic key parts validated (validate_keys.py: 44/44 integrity, 7/7 ECF); 68 items are explicitly conceptual (verbal/qualitative, no fixed numeric target derivable from a text response); 4 excluded or method-only because fixed numeric data is absent/defective; full 100-item corpus now has an explicit disposition. Not yet wired to production, not yet on an adjudicated gold set.
purpose: Declares the deterministic verification layer for AP Statistics grading (TASK-0016 Phase C, Engine 1 + Engine 3) and the per-item key/ECF payload it runs.

required_checks.scope: keyed computed values (CI bounds, test statistics, probabilities, r, slope) — result-presence within tolerance; 100% specificity on canonicals

algebraic equivalence of formula setups BEFORE arithmetic — catches the s/n vs s/sqrt(n) SE-error class and pooled-SE / Bayes-denominator structure; ABSTAINS on ambiguous typed notation (never false-flags)

multi-part consistency points: re-substitute the student's own upstream answers; award downstream parts computed correctly on a wrong upstream value; guardrails for conceptual-collapse, coincidental-canonical, and naked-answer
bias/confounding/causation, hypotheses statement, interpretation-in-context, reject/fail-to-reject decision — the criteria the deterministic layer ABSTAINS on

key_payload.part_schema: {id, points, canonical_formula (SymPy-parseable), givens{sym:value}, deps{sym:upstream_part_id}, canonical_answer, sign_sensitive?}
excluded_corpus_defect: APSTAT-MOD8-H001 (no dataset — value-specific claims isolated; method/self-consistency only)
APSTAT-MOD6-H002-INV (asks for graph/summaries/regression from unavailable SAT/GPA dataset; fixed-value key excluded)
APSTAT-MOD7-H004 (probability distribution not provided; formula-only/symbolic triage)
APSTAT-MOD7-H002-INV (complete anxiety/STEM table not derivable from given percentages; conditional probabilities only conceptual from stated 80%/40%)

tolerance_policy.note: per-item override allowed; must accommodate student rounding of intermediate values (AP grades 'consistent with the student's work'). Set critical-value / rounding conventions per item during boundary-contract authoring.
